hero.heading: Garden Retreat
hero.tagline: Two villas, one lush tropical garden

overview.body1: The Garden Retreat is a collection of two private villas set within a lush tropical garden — the Garden Family Villa and the Garden Junior Suite. Each offers a distinct experience, united by the same serene garden setting and Caribbean character.
overview.body2: Whether you choose the spacious Family Villa or the intimate Junior Suite, the Garden Retreat offers privacy, comfort, and a connection to the natural beauty of St. Vincent and the Grenadines.
